title: Manifold-Matching Autoencoders: Embedding Data into Chosen Geometric Structures
abstract: arXiv:2603.16568v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Manipulating the structure of data in the latent space of an autoencoder is a long-standing goal of representation learning. We propose a simple regularization, Manifold Matching, that imposes an explicit geometric structure on that latent space. The idea is to take a reference representation R of the data, which need not be the raw input X fed to the network, and to minimize, batch-wise, the mean squared error between the pairwise distances in R and those in the latent space Z. Although the autoencoder still learns to reconstruct X, the shape of its latent space comes to mimic that of R. The objective requires no labels, only reference distances, and because those are scalars, the dimensionality of R is decoupled from that of Z: any reference can guide any bottleneck. translated_title: 流形匹配自编码器：将数据嵌入到选定的几何结构中
translated_abstract: 操纵自编码器潜空间中数据的结构是表示学习领域的一个长期目标。我们提出了一种简单的正则化方法——流形匹配，它能够在潜空间上施加显式的几何结构。其核心思想是选取数据的一个参考表示R（它不必是输入网络的原始输入X），然后按批次最小化R中的成对距离与潜空间Z中的成对距离之间的均方误差。尽管自编码器仍然学习重建X，但其潜空间的形状会逐渐模仿R的形状。该目标不需要标签，只需要参考距离；而且由于这些距离是标量，R的维数与Z的维数相互解耦：任何参考都可以引导任何瓶颈层。利用这一单一工具，我们研究了如何在潜空间上施加不同的几何结构，并与基于几何或t…（方法）构建的自编码器进行了比较。
tldr: 提出一种名为“流形匹配”的简单正则化方法，通过最小化潜空间与任意参考表示之间成对距离的均方误差，使自编码器的潜空间能够被塑造成任意选定的几何结构，且无需标签、参考维数与潜空间维数自由解耦。
en_tdlr: A simple regularization called Manifold Matching shapes an autoencoder's latent space into any chosen geometric structure by minimizing the mean squared error between pairwise distances in the latent space and those of an arbitrary reference representation, requiring no labels and decoupling the reference's dimensionality from the latent space.
